title: Sierra Nevada Ecosystem Functional Types, 2001–2018
summary: Reconstruct annual MOD13Q1-derived EFAs, 64 EFTs, richness, rarity, and interannual stability for the Sierra Nevada fixed source-grid window.
evaluation: Evaluation checks exact delivery and schema, non-degeneracy, reproducibility, expert-product similarity, and independent field-phenology performance. Evaluation proceeds strictly through 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, and 1.0, stopping at the first failed gate. The 0.4 and 0.6 gates require both expert-product similarity and independent-validation non-inferiority; the 0.8 and 1.0 gates then add strict independent superiority. Private support and thresholds are not disclosed.

scoreSemantics.0.6: Expert-level quality (C tolerance AND B non-inferiority)
scoreSemantics.0.8: Beyond-expert (0.6 gates AND prespecified B improvement)
scoreSemantics.1.0: Stronger improvement (0.8 gates AND second independent axis or stronger frozen B evidence)
